On 14-5-2024 the respondent No.3 has been imposed penalty of Taka 50,000 under section 45 of the Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009 and imposing fine of Taka 2,00,000 under section 44 of the Consumers' Right Protection Act, 2009.
